report:
I'd merge this as it stands. Every requirement in the issue is met, all the checks pass, and none of my edge-case probes turned up a problem that has to be fixed first.

**What I ran**
- `node tests/run.mjs`: every check passes, ending with `All checks passed.` (exit 0). It covers all four pages:
  - nav, `aria-current`, landmarks and heading levels;
  - the skip link and visible focus on every Tab stop;
  - no horizontal scroll at 360px and 1280px;
  - no requests to other hosts and no console errors;
  - the genre filter, including `?genre=` values that are unknown, empty, upper-case, repeated or contain `&`, plus back and forward;
  - contact form validation, focus and `aria-invalid`.
- **Contrast:** I worked out the WCAG ratio for each colour pair. Nav links on the header are 7.37:1, the muted author text on cards 8.73:1, the genre tag 8.95:1, error text 8.62:1, button text 9.43:1 and the focus ring on the page background 8.26:1. All pass AA, and most pass AAA.
- **Opening from `file://`:** the filter still works on `books.html`. Choosing "Poetry & Essays" gave `?genre=Poetry+%26+Essays` and "Showing 2 of 12 books", with no errors.
- **320px wide:** none of the four pages scrolls sideways.
- **Content:** every event date is a Saturday, as listed. The genre counts add up to the "12 of 12" shown.
- **Repo conventions:** the base commit is empty, so there is nothing the change could break. The diff only adds files: nothing unrelated, no leftovers, no trailing whitespace or CRLF line endings. I removed my scratch directory, and `git status` is as I found it.

**Nits (not blocking)**
- `index.html`: the three cards are `h2` headings sitting under the `h2` "What you will find here". They read as subsections of it, so they should be `h3`.
- `visit.html`: the hours table caption says "every day of the week", but Monday is closed. It also repeats the "Opening hours" heading.
- `css/style.css`: the genre dropdown has `min-width: 12rem`. With the root font size doubled at 360px, I checked every element on all four pages: the dropdown is the only one that runs past the right edge (about 40px of sideways scroll). Normal sizes are fine.
- `js/visit.js`: after a successful demo submit, the form isn't cleared.
